name: magic-ui-lens
title: Lens Zoom
blurb: Circular magnifying lens follows cursor on hover, zooming and revealing detail.
description: Wraps content and creates a circular magnification lens that appears on hover. The lens position tracks cursor movement and zooms content within a circular radial mask.
use_when: Image galleries or product displays where hover magnification reveals fine detail in an elegant way.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices — magnifier requires pointer hover to appear.
a11y: Has aria-label and keyboard support (Escape to hide). Role region indicates interactive zoom area. Lens position is not keyboard-navigable.
